Stormlord is a famously picky little cat. 
She only eats the heads of fish, can't sleep if there's any light, and when playing, only lets people pet half her belly. 
But she wasn't always this delicate. 
Back when she was a stray, she drank the dirtiest ditch water, fed on rotten fish bones, and curled up through freezing blizzards. 
Until one day, in a heavy downpour, a hand that smelled faintly of osmanthus plucked her from beneath a wagon wheel. 
The person said that from now on, she can be the most pampered little cat in the world. 
One year passed... three years passed... Stormlord has lived happily as the most pampered little cat in the world.
